i.norm: Verifies that calling remove() on the iterator's current node (removing it from the tree) and then calling forEachRemaining() completes without error when no matching nodes remain. The iterator detects the structural change (removed current node) and recovers gracefully.
Build a document with a single child element to serve as the iterator's start node
Create an iterator that filters for FormElement nodes, starting at the child element
Remove the current node (the start element) from the document tree mid-iteration
After the structural removal, forEachRemaining should detect there are no matching nodes left and invoke the consumer zero times without throwing
